headline_marked: [[US threatens to impose toll in Strait of Hormuz]] if Iran talks fail, says Trump
headline: US threatens to impose toll in Strait of Hormuz if Iran talks fail, says Trump
summary: Former US President Donald Trump threatened to impose a toll on the Strait of Hormuz if negotiations with Iran fail, aiming to recover costs for protecting Middle Eastern nations. Analysts fear this could destabilize global oil markets.
details: Former US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a toll on the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global waterway, if ongoing discussions to end the war with Iran prove unsuccessful. He stated that this toll would compensate the United States for its long-standing expenses in protecting Middle Eastern countries.

President Trump issued this warning on Saturday morning local time, through a post on his social media platform, Truth Social. He explicitly wrote that if no agreement is reached with Iran, a toll will be imposed by the United States in the Strait of Hormuz, with the funds directly going to the US treasury.

Trump referred to the US as the 'Guardian Angel' for Middle Eastern nations, emphasizing that American forces have provided security to the region for an extended period. The proposed toll is intended to recoup the significant financial costs Washington has incurred for this protection.

A substantial portion of the world's total crude oil is transported daily through the Strait of Hormuz, making it a strategically highly sensitive waterway. Analysts are concerned that such a threat by the US to impose a toll could trigger major instability in international oil prices and global politics.
